texts: good. the day-525/Year-2 date lands on a reified 'the moon was new' state and the plain past copular fact is emitted alongside it, so both the dated and the undated question forms resolve.

mixed: everything but the time anchor is right — Mira, the three-person harvest party, the Tide-pools as destination and the past tense all land — but 'at the new-moon spring tide' is filled in with a bare kind symbol that the same parse also uses as a class, so the tide never becomes a thing you can ask about and an 'at' anchored on an event noun has no licensed attachment. Rewrite as "Mira led a harvest party of three people to the Salt-bloom Tide-pools during the new-moon spring tide." — 'during' is one of the three words that license event-inside-event containment, so the tide gets its own witness and the leading is placed inside it with no loss of meaning.
good. the harvest party from sentence 2 is reused as the harvester and the nine buckets are recorded as a measured amount of salt-bloom.

good. 'the harvest' resolves back to sentence 3's harvesting event, the Council is the recipient of the reporting, and 'the next morning' gives a morning time plus an explicit ordering after the harvest.
good. one past congratulating event with the Council as agent and Mira as the unchanged object.
good. the recording takes the same harvest event symbol as sentences 3 and 4, so all three sentences attach to one harvest.
